bbb.name: bbb

bbb.description: Blood-Brain Barrier permeability P(BBB+) trained on B3DB (Meng et al. 2021, 7,805 valid compounds); higher is better for CNS penetration.

pgp.name: pgp

cv_metrics.split_protocol: 5-fold Bemis-Murcko scaffold CV (zero scaffold overlap, INT8 quantized)

pgp.description: P-glycoprotein (ABCB1/MDR1) inhibition P(P-gp inhibitor) trained on TDC Pgp_Broccatelli (Broccatelli et al. 2011, 1,212 unique compounds). NOTE: Y=1 reflects P-gp inhibition rather than pure MDCK-MDR1 efflux substrate ratio; interpret alongside Pfizer CNS MPO v2's 2x HBD term for brain-efflux control.

herg.description: hERG K+ channel blockade cardiotoxicity P(hERG IC50 < 10 uM) trained on TDC hERG_Karim (Karim et al. 2021, 13,445 balanced compounds); lower is safer (critical QT-prolongation gate for psychiatric and pediatric Tourette drugs).
